author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
T.C. Stephen has fully explored the city of Venice in the final years of the Napoleonic Wars. Set in this former Republic, now absorbed by the Kingdom of Italy and full of discontent and mystical threats, the holy Inquisition and Agent Provocateurs, this expansion is a fully immersive new setting for Silver Bayonet. Let's check it out!

Thanks to Osprey for the complimentary copy of the book to review. 

Check out the book HERE: https://www.ospreypublishing.com/ca/silver-bayonet-venice-the-alchemists-legacy-9781472870292/

author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Ever find yourself playing Stargrave and you think "man... I really wish I had a tank...". Joe's got your back! Tanks, motorcycles, Fury-Road-Style-Gigahorses.... your Mercenary crew can buy them all. Acceptable Losses gives you the ability to run a Mercenary Crew and their war-ops either as a new concept for Stargrave or integrated into your existing campaign.

Check out the book HERE: https://www.ospreypublishing.com/ca/stargrave-acceptable-losses-9781472875587/

Big thanks to Osprey for the complimentary copy of the book to review. 

Music "Retrofuture Nasty" by Kevin McLeod used via Creative Commons
title: GMG Reviews - STARGRAVE - Acceptable Losses by Joe McCullough & Osprey Games

author: Guerrilla Miniature Games
description:
Since September I've been busily setting up interviews to learn a bit more about what's going on at Rackham Studios who are hard at work bringing the world of Aarklash to its fans. Today I'm joined by Boris, the head Rules developer for INCARNATION and a twenty-five year veteran of Confrontation with a COMPLETE collection of models and cards from the original game. He and his team have been hard at work on the new rules and today we're going to get our first looks at what is to come when INCARNATION launches next year!

Follow INCARNATION on Gamefound for free models if you back the campaign! https://gamefound.com/en/projects/monolith-board-games-sarl/incarnation

Thanks to Monolith and Rackham Studios for sponsoring this video.
